summary: Stocks gapped lower on the hot CPI (S&P -0.7%, Nasdaq -1% at the open) but pared most losses, S&P about -0.2% and Nasdaq near flat, so the index puts were flipped to dip-reclaim calls while Nvidia is now the weak spot on the $7.5B China-shipments report. Quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news snippets.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Premarket bounce failed and shares are down about 3% on The Information report that Huang's ties enabled $7.5B of China chip shipments; losing Monday's 170.24 low opens 166 (price estimated).

picks.name: Hims & Hers Health
picks.reason: Weak Q4 guide and EBITDA cut keep pressure on after a 12% drop Monday; a break of 21.20 extends the slide (price estimated).

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Holding a ~3% earnings gap on GTA VI preorders and the Nov 19 launch; a push through 219.50 extends the trend (price estimated).

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: Bought the hot-CPI gap down from about 748 back to -0.2%; reclaiming Monday's 753 close turns the day green toward 757, losing the opening low resumes the fade.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq recovered from -1% at the open to about flat despite Nvidia's drop; a move over 681 (Monday's close area) extends the reversal, under 672 retests the lows.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: After a 13% one-day surge to 508.58 it slipped premarket and is vulnerable to profit-taking with rate-hike bets rising; under 496 targets 486 (price estimated).
